content: DNS lookup tools (dnschecker.org, mxtoolbox, getzenquery, itoolverse, toolpage.dev) commonly support A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT/NS plus often SOA and CAA; some also PTR and SRV. Differentiators: global propagation checking across 20+ geographic resolver locations with a map visualization (dnschecker.org signature feature), full domain health checks (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/nameserver consistency), DNSSEC validation status per record, and mail-server diagnostics/blacklist checks (mxtoolbox signature). Newer minimalist tools (getzenquery, itoolverse, toolpage.dev) run client-side against a single DoH provider (commonly Cloudflare) and surface TTL + response/query time per record, matching this brief's planned baseline.
